versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.1 is a major cleanup and simplification release.

- Removed six files, including all code, tests, and documentation except SKILL.md.
- Downgraded SKILL.md to version 1.0.0 content; latest usage and description preserved.
- All source files, rule logic, and supplementary docs have been deleted.
- The skill now consists only of a static description (no implementation).
v2.0.0 重写为经验驱动方向

presales-win-blueprint 1.0.0 初始版本发布

- 基于李宁17年售前实战经验，提供规则化售前方案辅助
- 支持输入客户、行业、阶段、竞品等参数生成个性化现场策略与攻防要点
- 输出包含阶段定位、竞品攻防、风险预警、方案自检清单和经验总结
- 覆盖方案比稿、客户控场、大单推进、方案自检等实务场景
- 提供多种交互和快速使用方式，适配Sales、PM等角色
